day_shape: 69 items: US-Iran reportedly closing on one-page deal to end war, Trump pauses Hormuz naval escorts after Saudi pressure, IDF strikes Beirut for first time since ceasefire, OFAC publishes Iran GLs S and T, heavy Khamenei/IRIB messaging cycle.

threads.label: US-Iran framework deal reportedly near
threads.summary: Multiple outlets reported Washington and Tehran closing in on a one-page memo to end the war and launch nuclear talks, with Tehran expected to respond within 48 hours per Axios. Times of Israel said Trump renewed bomb threats while officials close to Netanyahu told the Jerusalem Post he was not surprised by Wednesday's developments.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade and naval escort pause
threads.summary: Trump paused US naval escorts through the Strait of Hormuz citing 'great progress' in Iran talks, with the Jerusalem Post reporting Saudi pressure behind the decision and South Korea suspending its review of joining the escort operation. CENTCOM said USS George H.W. Bush remained on station and 52 commercial vessels had been turned around under the blockade; Iran's Seoul embassy denied involvement in damage to a South Korean ship.

threads.label: Iran oil shipments under blockade
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Iran storing roughly two million barrels on the 30-year-old tanker Nasha off Kharg Island in the fourth week of the US naval blockade, and that the US struck an Iranian-flagged ship in the Gulf of Oman during peace talks. Defa Press cited Tanker Trackers claiming empty Iranian tankers including VINA/VALLEY were breaking through the blockade into the Strait of Hormuz.

threads.label: Lebanon and Hezbollah strikes
threads.summary: The IDF struck Beirut for the first time since the ceasefire, targeting Hezbollah's Radwan special forces commander, and two Israeli soldiers were wounded in a Hezbollah drone attack in southern Lebanon. Times of Israel reported Hezbollah attempting to send reinforcements south to replace hundreds of operatives killed, while Syria's Interior Ministry said it had dismantled a Hezbollah-linked assassination cell.

threads.label: OFAC sanctions publications
threads.summary: OFAC published two Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations general licenses, GLs S and T, in the Federal Register. The same notice batch included seven Venezuela Sanctions Regulations general licenses (46, 46A, 46B, 47, 48, 49, 50) previously available on OFAC's website.

threads.label: Khamenei and IRIB wartime messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a Workers' Day and Teachers' Day message from Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei and a strategy document on managing the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz, while IRIB ran a 67th-night cycle of provincial 'nights of power' gatherings invoking the martyred Supreme Leader. Defa Press claimed America was at a 'strategic deadlock' and alleged a foiled uranium-theft operation in Mahyar plain involving 440kg of enriched uranium.

threads.label: Iran domestic dissent and crackdown
threads.summary: Iran International reported at least 30 women detained in recent protests held in overcrowded basement conditions at Vakilabad prison in Mashhad, and three Iranian prisoners detailed torture to the Jerusalem Post. Other Iran International pieces flagged hardline state TV rhetoric, hijab-enforcement tensions during the wartime unity push, and tools to bypass Iran's internet shutdowns.

events.title_en: Uranium dilution; enemy diplomatic plot after failure of historic theft in Mahyar plain
events.summary_en: Uranium dilution; enemy diplomatic plot after failure of historic theft in Mahyar plain. Following the failure of the uranium theft operation in Mahyar plain and the thwarting of the possibility of removing 440 kilograms of Iran's enriched uranium, the enemy is now focused on the plot of 'uranium dilution' through diplomacy. It must be noted that uranium dilution makes no difference to handing it over to the enemy. Reuters has claimed that about half of this enriched uranium is stored in tunnels at Isfahan's nuclear research centre. Eric Brouwer, former senior CIA analyst, says: Iran still has all its nuclear materials and these materials are probably located in deep underground sites.

events.title_en: Nationwide elections in Britain have begun / Major test for the Starmer government
events.summary_en: Nationwide elections in Britain have begun / Major test for the Starmer government. Voting in a series of local, municipal and parliamentary elections across England, Scotland and Wales has begun; elections described as the biggest political test of the Starmer government since the 2024 general elections. In these elections, which are held on Thursday, millions of voters across Britain head to the polls to decide on the composition of local councils, the parliaments of Scotland and Wales, and several mayoral positions. The results of these elections are considered among the most important political events of the year in Britain and could bring significant changes.

events.title_en: Foreign Policy: America's war with Iran has put Ukraine's air defence system in limbo
events.summary_en: Foreign Policy: America's war with Iran has put Ukraine's air defence system in limbo. Ukraine and its allies are awaiting an American decision to continue delivering Patriot systems. Patriot systems are 'the backbone of Ukraine's defence against Russian missiles and any disruption in their supply can increase Ukraine's vulnerability. The widespread use of air defence missiles in the war with Iran has put pressure on global supplies and concerns about the speed of replacement of these systems have increased, putting Ukraine in an uncertain position against Russian attacks.

events.summary_en: Financial Times: 'Worst' days of oil price volatility lie ahead. Oil price volatility has clouded global trade prospects. According to Global Trade Alert analysis, price volatility is more damaging than price increases and will lead to a reduction in commodity flows at the global level. The effects of fuel price swings appear up to 19 months after occurrence; therefore, despite the current relative stability in container shipping rates, the worst consequences of renewed shipping rate contracts and declining consumer confidence are still ahead.
